rv.q: “Seussical the Musical” at San Diego Musical Theatre thorugh June 7th, is colorful chaos in its most delightful form, an energetic, sentimental, and joyfully silly production that embraces the heart and whimsy of Dr. Seuss’s beloved worlds.
What an adorable good time this show is!

rv.o: To See or Not to See
rv.q: SDMT put on a great production; don't let these colorful characters pass you by!
Fortunately, the production co-directed by Xavier J. Bush and Van Angelo, with choreography by Bush, is filled with imagination, movement, playfulness and poignancy.

cn.t: Critics praise this colorful, family-friendly production for its energetic performances, charming whimsy, and strong choreography, though it's more sweet than groundbreaking—a delightful romp through Dr. Seuss's beloved worlds.
